meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已装好的 Dial 通道再加一个电话号码,这样一个 NanoClaw 安装就能在多个号码上收发短信和 AI 语音通话。每个号码是独立的分线会话,回复会从收到消息的那个号码发出。
howto.when: 当 Dial 通道已经装好、你又想要额外一个号码(比如个人线加支持线)时使用。前置条件是已安装支持多号码的 Dial 适配器。

say.text: 帮我给 Dial 再加一个号码
say.note: 它会先确认 Dial 已装好,再列出账号里的号码

say.text: 把 +14155550123 这条线接到某个 agent 组
say.note: 它会问这条线叫什么、谁能发消息

say.text: 重启服务并验证新号码这条线
say.note: 重启后核对号码与 agent 组的绑定

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an already-installed Dial channel, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on several numbers. Each number is its own threaded line; replies leave from the number that received the message.
howto.when_en: Use when the Dial channel is already installed and you want an extra number, e.g. a personal line plus a support line. It requires the multi-number Dial adapter.

say_en.note: It confirms Dial is installed, then lists the account's numbers
It asks for the line name and who may text it

say_en.text: Restart and verify the new line
say_en.note: It restarts the service and checks the wiring
